title: A practical approach to quantitative analytical surface-enhanced Raman spectroscopy
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,62-84
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00861H, Tutorial Review
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yikai Xu, Wafaa Aljuhani, Yingrui Zhang, Ziwei Ye, Chunchun Li, Steven E. J. Bell
The high sensitivity, molecular specificity and speed of analysis make SERS an attractive analytical technique. This review draws out the underlying principles for analytical SERS and provides practical tips and tricks for SERS quantitation.
